text:
Emma (CS): Quick kickoff for Helio Health onboarding — want to align stakeholders, success criteria, timelines, and renewal risks. Looping in @raju, @melissa, @jordan. Can folks confirm availability for an initial 30m sync?

Raju (SE): Available. Tech notes up front: we'll need a VPC peering window and SP metadata for SAML. ETA for infra readiness ~2 weeks once peering approved. Also need staging cert for TLS. Example firewall rule we'll ask them to provide: ```allow from 203.0.113.0/24 to 10.48.0.0/24```

Melissa (PM): From CS side, proposed success metrics: time-to-first-successful-call <=48h, p95 latency <200ms, pilot cohort of 5 users with pass-rate >80% on eval prompts. Renewal risk: if integration slips past 60 days they escalate procurement. Recommend we track an interim QA milestone at day 21.

Jordan (CE): I'll run enablement: 2 sessions — API quickstart + observability walkthrough. Propose Tue/Thu next week 10–11am PT. Will prepare a demo notebook and slides. Also suggest we capture feedback via short survey after session.

Emma (CS): Stakeholder roster from Helio: Kara Lin (PM), Marco Ruiz (Eng), Priya Shah (Infra). Kara asked for SSO + data retention notes up front. I'll send calendar invites once we lock dates.

Raju (SE): SSO note: Redwood supports SAML2.0. We'll need SP metadata and ACS URL from Helio, plus IP whitelist for egress. If Helio can share staging cert that speeds testing.

Melissa (PM): Short success checklist I'll maintain: 1) Auth + test call, 2) Eval prompts pass >80%, 3) Cost estimate agreed, 4) Runbooks for failover + escalation. I'll create a sheet and share edit rights.

Onboard Bot: Created workspace "helio-health-onboard" in Console — https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/helio-health. Permissions: Emma, Raju, Melissa, Jordan granted.

Jordan (CE): Tentative enablement agenda: 15m intros, 30m quickstart (live demo), 30m observability (dashboards + tracing), 15m Q&A. I'll upload slides and the demo notebook to the workspace before the session.

Emma (CS): Draft timeline: week1 — infra & auth, week2 — pilot integration, week3 — scale & operational review. If we hit blockers by EOD Fri flag here. @Kara — can you confirm SAML metadata timeline?

Kara Lin (Helio): Hi all — Kara here. SAML metadata will be ready Tue next week, staging cert can be handed off this Fri. Pilot users ready the week after that.

Emma (CS): Perfect. Action items: Raju — open VPC peering req and share firewall template; Jordan — send invites + slides; Melissa — create success checklist sheet; Emma — send kickoff note + calendar. I'll also start a short risk register doc.

Melissa (PM): Flagging procurement/renewal risk: procurement needs a signed MSA within 45 days to avoid a purchasing freeze. I'll start drafting SOW and loop legal on Monday.

Emma (CS): Quick poll for canary deploy date: March 18 (:thumbsup:) or March 25 (:eyes:). Please react.

Marco Ruiz (Helio): :thumbsup: from infra — 18 works for us.

Emma (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate notes and post a follow-up with calendar invites and the risk register link later today.
